newsitem.title: INDIA: Kashmir landmine blast kills three Indian soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Kashmir landmine blast kills three Indian soldiers.

text.p: A landmine explosion triggered by suspected separatist guerrillas on Tuesday killed three Indian soldiers in the troubled state of Jammu and Kashmir, police said.
They said suspected militants detonated the mine when a group of soldiers passed while patrolling a road near Handwara town, 74 km (45 miles) north of the state's summer capital Srinagar.
Police said the blast also wounded three soldiers.
A landmine explosion in Srinagar on Monday killed two civilians and injured a police official.
More than a dozen militant groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir, India's only Moslem-majority region.
Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have been killed in seven years of separatist-related violence in the Himalayan region.
But separatists and the state's chief minister, Farooq Abdullah put the toll near 50,000.
